title: Patroni & repmgr
description: Use Patroni and repmgr for automatic failover.

data.text: Patroni and repmgr automate failover and cluster management for PostgreSQL.

data.title: Patroni
data.code:
scope: postgresql-cluster
namespace: /service/postgresql
name: node1

restapi:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:8008
  connect_address: 10.0.0.1:8008

etcd:
  hosts: 10.0.0.1:2379

postgresql:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:5432
  connect_address: 10.0.0.1:5432
  data_dir: /var/lib/postgresql/data
  authentication:
    replication:
      username: replicator
      password: secret
    superuser:
      username: postgres
      password: secret

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use Patroni with etcd, Consul, or ZooKeeper for distributed consensus.
